core.headline: Brook Hall: Edwardian country house, 4.5 acres, near Frant
core.summary: Detached Edwardian country house with approx. 4.5 acres including paddock, heated pool, oak-framed triple cart lodge with annexe, and gated drive, near Frant station and Royal Tunbridge Wells
core.listing:
Brook Hall is a detached Edwardian country house with approximately 4.5 acres, set near Frant in the High Weald National Landscape. The property is approached via a gated drive and includes a three-acre paddock, a heated outdoor pool and an oak-framed triple cart lodge with a one-bedroom annexe above.

The house was built in 1908 with brick and tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. The ground floor provides four reception rooms: a drawing room measuring 7.10m x 5.20m (23'4" x 17'1"), a dining room measuring 5.40m x 4.60m (17'9" x 15'1"), and two further reception rooms.

The kitchen and breakfast room measures 8.20m x 4.90m (26'11" x 16'1").

There are five bedrooms and four bathrooms. The principal bedroom measures 5.60m x 4.80m (18'4" x 15'9").

The gardens include a terrace and a heated outdoor pool served by an air source heat pump. The paddock extends to approximately three acres. The oak-framed triple cart lodge was built in 2025 following planning permission granted that year; the one-bedroom annexe is above.

Frant station is approximately 2 miles (London Bridge approximately 1 hour by rail). Royal Tunbridge Wells is approximately 4 miles.

Guide Price £2,100,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band H (Wealden District Council). EPC rating E. Construction: Standard – Brick with tile-hung upper elevations under a clay-tiled roof. Mains electricity and water (not metered). Sewerage: treatment plant. Oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: limited indoors; good outdoor coverage. Parking: gated drive with parking for several cars; triple cart lodge. The property is within the High Weald National Landscape. A public footpath crosses the southern edge of the paddock. Planning permission was granted in 2025 for the cart lodge with annexe above (built). Council tax banding of the annexe has not been confirmed.
